title: Error analysis for the numerical approximation of the quantile hedging problem
abstract: arXiv:2611.26673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We analyse numerical approximations of quantile hedging in complete linear markets with Markovian diffusion dynamics. The problem is formulated as stochastic control for an augmented state $(X,P)$, where the probability martingale $P$ is constrained to $[0,1]$ and controlled through an unbounded volatility coefficient. We combine control truncation with piecewise-constant policy time-stepping (PCPT), stopping controls continuously upon boundary hitting to preserve the state constraint. Using one-step dynamic programming principles and regularisation, we derive a generator inequality and explicit value-function error bounds. Under standard coefficient regularity and a Lipschitz payoff, optimising the truncation and regularisation parameters yields an error exponent arbitrarily close to $1/8$ from below, uniformly in the probability variable. translated_title: 分位数对冲问题数值逼近的误差分析
translated_abstract: 我们分析了具有马尔可夫扩散动力学的完备线性市场中分位数对冲问题的数值逼近。该问题被表述为对增广状态 $(X,P)$ 的随机控制问题，其中概率鞅 $P$ 被约束在 $[0,1]$ 区间内，并通过一个无界的波动率系数进行控制。我们将控制截断与分段常值策略时间步进（PCPT）相结合，在触及边界时连续停止控制以保持状态约束。利用单步动态规划原理和正则化技术，我们推导出了一个生成元不等式以及显式的值函数误差界。在标准的系数正则性和 Lipschitz 收益函数条件下，通过优化截断和正则化参数，可以获得任意接近但不达到 $1/8$ 的误差指数，且该指数在概率变量上是一致成立的。对于从一开始就有界的控制，我们获得了任意接近但不达到 $1/4$ 的指数（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文针对完备马尔可夫扩散市场中的分位数对冲问题，通过控制截断与分段常值策略时间步进相结合的数值方法，推导出显式的值函数误差界，并将误差指数优化至任意接近 1/8（当控制有界时接近 1/4）。
en_tdlr: This paper derives explicit value-function error bounds for numerical approximations of quantile hedging in complete Markovian diffusion markets, achieving error exponents arbitrarily close to 1/8 (or 1/4 with bounded controls) by combining control truncation with piecewise-constant policy time-stepping.
